prompt: What is the module system (JPMS) restriction on reflection?
choices: Reflection is completely disabled inside modules
Modules can limit reflective access to their packages; frameworks may need '--add-opens' to work
Only private fields can be accessed reflectively in a module
Reflection only works across module boundaries
explanation: Java modules (Java 9+) can use 'opens package to framework' to allow reflective access. Without it, setAccessible(true) on a class in a non-opened module throws InaccessibleObjectException. The --add-opens JVM flag is a common workaround when using older frameworks.
